_comment: Known agent screens for the Watchdog. First match wins, in order. window = how many of the last non-empty lines are searched; footer = a menu footer (enter to confirm / esc to ...) must be in the last 8 lines, so an answer that only MENTIONS a prompt is not one (fixture-claude-answer-mentions-trust.txt). kind: secret (never answered: needs-owner), trust (answered only inside the goal project), choice (decided, then sent), popup, queued, capacity, model-error, rate-limited. keys = what is sent; 'menu:yes' picks the yes/trust option of a numbered or arrow menu. Add a line for a new CLI prompt.

prompts.name: sign-in
prompts.pattern: (?i)not logged in|not signed in|please (log|sign) ?in|run /login|invalid api key|authentication (failed|required)|oauth|login required

prompts.name: claude-trust
prompts.pattern: (?i)do you trust the files in this folder|is this a project you created or one you trust|yes, i trust this folder

prompts.name: codex-trust
prompts.pattern: (?i)do you trust the contents of this (directory|project)|trust this folder\?

prompts.name: cline-queued
prompts.pattern: (?i)queued messages|enter with empty input to steer

prompts.name: codex-capacity
prompts.pattern: (?i)selected model is at capacity|model is (currently )?overloaded|overloaded_error|server is at capacity

prompts.name: model-not-found
prompts.pattern: (?i)model not found|unknown model|model .{0,40} does not exist|invalid model

prompts.name: account-limit
prompts.pattern: (?i)you've hit your (usage )?limit|usage limit (reached|exceeded)|(5-hour|weekly|session) limit reached|rate limit(ed)? (reached|exceeded)|limit will reset|try again at \d
